description.value:
Every slot. GM-permission item. Not one donor — several, harvested and grown together into a single graft that overwrites the whole body at once. +2 apex item bonus to all physical ability scores. Fast Healing 10. Resistance 10 to physical and poison damage. Choose one donor's trained skill and one language, gained permanently, on install.

Rider: You are already Chorus the moment the graft closes. Renegotiating who's driving isn't a future event on this card — the GM may start doing it this session.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 apex item bonus to all physical ability scores has no confirmed hook, same finding as every other apex clause in this pass. The permanent free skill/language pick on install is a one-time character-build choice, not a standing rule (closer to a ChoiceSet made once at creation than an ongoing effect, and the specific 'donor's trained skill' set isn't known in advance to author a ChoiceSet against). The Chorus-immediately rider is narrative GM adjudication.
